# Generated by tools/build_managers.py.
# The Records: one line of a log, for the country in scope. The caller has set the temporary variables
# ev_kind, ev_fam, ev_kid, ev_a, ev_b, ev_sa and ev_sb (tools/build_records.py, line()). The oldest line goes past 500.
# Each kind of line is counted (mod1440_ct), a line of the territory log in that log only.
mod1440_ev_add = {
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_date = global.date }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_day = global.num_days }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_kind = ev_kind }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_fam = ev_fam }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_a = ev_a }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_b = ev_b }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_sa = ev_sa }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_sb = ev_sb }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_date^num > 500 } }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_date index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_day index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_kind index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_fam index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_a index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_b index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_sa index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_sb index = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ev_fam = 2 } } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 44
			value = pad_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ct^num < 44 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_ct = 0 }
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_ct^ev_kid = 1 }
	}
}

mod1440_tr_add = {
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_date = global.date }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_day = global.num_days }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_kind = ev_kind }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_fam = ev_fam }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_a = ev_a }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_b = ev_b }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_sa = ev_sa }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_sb = ev_sb }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_date^num > 500 } }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_date index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_day index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_kind index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_fam index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_a index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_b index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_sa index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_sb index = 0 }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = 44
		value = pad_n
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ct^num < 44 } }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_ct = 0 }
		}
	}
	add_to_variable = { mod1440_ct^ev_kid = 1 }
}

# The Records: which rows of a list are striped: 0, 1, 0, 1 ... for 512 rows.
mod1440_rec_odd = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_odd^num < 512 } }
		set_temp_variable = { odd_v = 0 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 512
			value = odd_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_odd^num < 512 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_odd = odd_v }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { odd_v = 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { odd_v = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { odd_v = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# War Diary: copies the lines the chosen filter wants, newest first, 200 from the chosen place, into the arrays
# the page draws. Territory has a log of its own; every other filter reads the main log. Then the figures
# of the record: sums of the counters, and the days since it began.
mod1440_wd_list = {
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_date
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_kind
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_fam
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_a
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_b
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_sa
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_sb
	set_temp_variable = { wd_seen = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 2 } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_tr_date^num
			value = wd_n
			set_temp_variable = { wd_m = mod1440_tr_date^num }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wd_m = 1 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wd_m = wd_n }
			set_temp_variable = { wd_ok = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wd_ok = 1 } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { wd_seen = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { wd_seen > mod1440_wd_from } check_variable = { mod1440_wd_fam^num < 200 } }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_date = mod1440_tr_date^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_kind = mod1440_tr_kind^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_fam = mod1440_tr_fam^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_a = mod1440_tr_a^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_b = mod1440_tr_b^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_sa = mod1440_tr_sa^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_sb = mod1440_tr_sb^wd_m }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_ev_date^num
			value = wd_n
			set_temp_variable = { wd_m = mod1440_ev_date^num }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wd_m = 1 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wd_m = wd_n }
			set_temp_variable = { wd_ok = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter > 0 } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_fam^wd_m = mod1440_wd_filter } } }
				set_temp_variable = { wd_ok = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wd_ok = 1 } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { wd_seen = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { wd_seen > mod1440_wd_from } check_variable = { mod1440_wd_fam^num < 200 } }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_date = mod1440_ev_date^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_kind = mod1440_ev_kind^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_fam = mod1440_ev_fam^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_a = mod1440_ev_a^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_b = mod1440_ev_b^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_sa = mod1440_ev_sa^wd_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_sb = mod1440_ev_sb^wd_m }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_total = wd_seen }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_0 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_2 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_3 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_4 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_5 = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_0 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_1 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 2 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_2 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 3 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_3 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 4 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_4 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 5 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_5 = 2 }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = 44
		value = pad_n
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ct^num < 44 } }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_ct = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^2 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^3 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_wars = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^4 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_peace = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^5 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_cap = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^7 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_annex = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^14 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^16 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_taken = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^15 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^17 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_lost = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^16 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_capitals = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^21 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^22 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^24 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_govs = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^27 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_comm = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^28 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_prom = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^30 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_dec = ct_sum }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_days = global.num_days }
	subtract_from_variable = { mod1440_wd_days = mod1440_ev_since_day }
	add_to_variable = { mod1440_rec_dirty = 1 }
}

# Officers: marks every officer who serves today with the day, and adds an officer the record does not know
# yet to its list. A retired officer keeps his place in that list (X34).
mod1440_of_seen = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = army_leaders
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_seen_day = global.num_days }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_known = 1 } } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_of_known = 1 }
			add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_of_known = THIS }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = navy_leaders
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_seen_day = global.num_days }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_known = 1 } } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_of_known = 1 }
			add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_of_known = THIS }
		}
	}
}

# Officers: makes the list of the page again: who the filter wants, in the order of the chosen column,
# every second row marked for its stripe.
mod1440_of_list = {
	mod1440_of_seen = yes
	clear_array = mod1440_of_rows
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = mod1440_of_known
		set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_show = 5 } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_seen_day < global.num_days } } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_show = 5 } } check_variable = { mod1440_of_seen_day < global.num_days } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_show = 1 } is_navy_leader = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_show = 2 } NOT = { is_navy_leader = yes } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_show = 3 } check_variable = { num_units < 1 } check_variable = { num_ships < 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_show = 4 } check_variable = { mod1440_of_dec^num < 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { of_keep = 1 } }
			add_to_array = { ROOT.mod1440_of_rows = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_sort_by > 0 } }
		clear_array = mod1440_of_keys
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = mod1440_of_rows
			set_temp_variable = { of_key = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = skill_level }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = attack_level }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = defense_level }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = planning_level }
				if = {
					limit = { is_navy_leader = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { of_key = maneuvering_level }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = logistics_level }
				if = {
					limit = { is_navy_leader = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { of_key = coordination_level }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 6 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = num_traits }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 7 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = num_units }
				if = {
					limit = { is_navy_leader = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { of_key = num_ships }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 8 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = mod1440_of_won }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 9 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = mod1440_of_lost }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 10 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = mod1440_of_dec^num }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_up = 1 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { of_key = -1 }
			}
			add_to_array = { ROOT.mod1440_of_keys = of_key }
		}
		clear_array = mod1440_of_sorted
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_of_rows^num
			value = of_step
			find_highest_in_array = {
				array = mod1440_of_keys
				value = of_high
				index = of_at
			}
			add_to_array = { mod1440_of_sorted = mod1440_of_rows^of_at }
			set_variable = { mod1440_of_keys^of_at = -2000000 }
		}
		clear_array = mod1440_of_rows
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_of_sorted
			value = of_copy
			add_to_array = { mod1440_of_rows = of_copy }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { of_par = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = mod1440_of_rows
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_odd = of_par }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { of_par = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_par = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { of_par = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_0 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_2 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_3 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_4 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_5 = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_show = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_0 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_show = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_1 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_show = 2 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_2 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_show = 3 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_3 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_show = 4 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_4 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_show = 5 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_5 = 2 }
	}
	mod1440_md_list = yes
	mod1440_of_card = yes
}

# Officers: copies the chosen officer's values, record, decorations and diary lines to the country, where
# his file reads them. His own values are read in his scope (X33).
mod1440_of_card = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_has_sel = 1 } }
		clear_array = mod1440_of_c_dec_key
		clear_array = mod1440_of_c_dec_date
		clear_array = mod1440_of_c_dec_set
		clear_array = mod1440_of_c_dec_frame
		var:mod1440_of_sel = {
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_skill = skill_level }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_rank = 2 }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_cmd = num_units }
			if = {
				limit = { is_field_marshal = yes }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_rank = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_navy_leader = yes }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_rank = 3 }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_cmd = num_ships }
			}
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_won = mod1440_of_won }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_lost = mod1440_of_lost }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_states = mod1440_of_states }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_since = mod1440_of_since }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_has_since = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_since_day > 0 } }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_has_since = 1 }
			}
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_prom = mod1440_of_prom }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_has_prom = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_prom_day > 0 } }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_has_prom = 1 }
			}
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_lvl = mod1440_of_lvl }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_has_lvl = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_lvl_day > 0 } }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_has_lvl = 1 }
			}
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_former = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_seen_day < global.num_days } }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_former = 1 }
			}
			for_each_loop = {
				array = mod1440_of_dec_key
				value = of_v
				add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_dec_key = of_v }
			}
			for_each_loop = {
				array = mod1440_of_dec_date
				value = of_v
				add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_dec_date = of_v }
			}
			for_each_loop = {
				array = mod1440_of_dec_set
				value = of_v
				add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_dec_set = of_v }
			}
			for_each_loop = {
				array = mod1440_of_dec_frame
				value = of_v
				add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_dec_frame = of_v }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_c_dec_n = mod1440_of_c_dec_key^num }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 7
			value = pad_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_c_dec_key^num < 7 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_c_dec_key = token:mod1440_blank }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_c_dec_date = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_c_dec_set = -1 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_c_dec_frame = 1 }
			}
		}
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_md_id
			value = md_v
			index = md_i
			set_temp_variable = { md_h = 0 }
			var:mod1440_of_sel = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_of_dec value = md_v } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_h = 1 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_md_has^md_i = md_h }
		}
		clear_array = mod1440_of_ln_date
		clear_array = mod1440_of_ln_kind
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_ev_date^num
			value = of_n
			set_temp_variable = { of_m = mod1440_ev_date^num }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { of_m = 1 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { of_m = of_n }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sa^of_m = 1 } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_a^of_m = mod1440_of_sel } check_variable = { mod1440_of_ln_date^num < 7 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_date = mod1440_ev_date^of_m }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_kind = mod1440_ev_kind^of_m }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_ln_n = mod1440_of_ln_date^num }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 7
			value = pad_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_ln_date^num < 7 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_date = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_kind = token:mod1440_blank }
			}
		}
	}
	add_to_variable = { mod1440_rec_dirty = 1 }
}

		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:CZE_war_cross }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = 3 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 4 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_md_count = mod1440_md_id^num }
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = 12
		value = pad_n
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_md_id^num < 12 } }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_md_id = 0 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_md_key = token:mod1440_blank }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_md_set = -1 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_md_frame = 1 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_md_has = 0 }
		}
	}
}

# Officers: gives the chosen officer the medal of slot md_k, once. A record of the mod: arrays on the
# officer. The War Diary gets a line.
mod1440_md_award = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_has_sel = 1 } check_variable = { md_k < mod1440_md_count } }
		set_temp_variable = { md_id = mod1440_md_id^md_k }
		set_temp_variable = { md_key = mod1440_md_key^md_k }
		set_temp_variable = { md_set = mod1440_md_set^md_k }
		set_temp_variable = { md_frame = mod1440_md_frame^md_k }
		set_temp_variable = { md_done = 0 }
		var:mod1440_of_sel = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_of_dec value = md_id } } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_dec = md_id }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_dec_key = md_key }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_dec_date = global.date }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_dec_set = md_set }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_dec_frame = md_frame }
				set_temp_variable = { md_done = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { md_done = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_decorated }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 4 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 30 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = mod1440_of_sel }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
		mod1440_of_card = yes
	}
}
mod1440_md_takeback = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_has_sel = 1 } }
		var:mod1440_of_sel = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_dec^num > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { md_n = mod1440_of_dec^num }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { md_n = 1 }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_of_dec index = md_n }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_of_dec_key index = md_n }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_of_dec_date index = md_n }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_of_dec_set index = md_n }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_of_dec_frame index = md_n }
			}
		}
		mod1440_of_card = yes
	}
}

# Government: compares who holds each office with yesterday's copy. A new name gets today's date and a line
# in the War Diary, a name that is gone a line. The first run only takes the copy. Then the laws in force,
# the length of the parties' bars and the figures of the record.
mod1440_gv_daily = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_leader = country_leader } } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_leader = country_leader }
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_leader_since = global.date }
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_leader_old = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_begun = 1 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_leader_old = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_leader }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 3 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 24 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = country_leader }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_character = { is_army_chief = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_has = 1 } check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0 = army_chief } } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0 = army_chief }
			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_has = 1 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_since = global.date }
			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_old = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_begun = 1 } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_old = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_appointed }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 3 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 25 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_a = army_chief }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
				mod1440_ev_add = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_has = 1 } }

				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_begun = 1 } }

				set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 26 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_a = mod1440_gv_of_0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
				mod1440_ev_add = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = {

			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1_has = 1 } check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1 = navy_chief } } }

			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1_has = 1 }

	clear_array = mod1440_gv_new
	clear_array = mod1440_gv_new_since
	clear_array = mod1440_gv_new_old
	for_each_loop = {
		array = political_advisor
		value = gv_c
		set_temp_variable = { gv_since = global.date }
		set_temp_variable = { gv_old = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_begun = 1 } }

		set_temp_variable = { gv_found = 0 }

	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = all_adults_serve }
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_law_2 = token:all_adults_serve }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = scraping_the_barrel }
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_law_2 = token:scraping_the_barrel }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = ETH_chitet_law }
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_law_2 = token:ETH_chitet_law }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = ETH_chitet_law_peace_time }
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_law_2 = token:ETH_chitet_law_peace_time }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = SWI_citizen_militia_1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_law_2 = token:SWI_citizen_militia_1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = SWI_citizen_militia_2 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_law_2 = token:SWI_citizen_militia_2 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_gv_pop_0 = party_popularity_100@fascism }
	set_variable = { mod1440_gv_pop_1 = party_popularity_100@democratic }
	set_variable = { mod1440_gv_pop_2 = party_popularity_100@communism }
	set_variable = { mod1440_gv_pop_3 = party_popularity_100@neutrality }
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = 44
		value = pad_n
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ct^num < 44 } }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_ct = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^23 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_gv_n_elections = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^21 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^22 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_gv_n_changes = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^24 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_gv_n_heads = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^25 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_gv_n_appointed = ct_sum }
	set_variable = { mod1440_gv_begun = 1 }
}

# Wars: a row for the enemy in wr_c, from today (wr_old = 1: the war ran when the record began).
mod1440_wr_open = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_wr_enemy value = wr_c } } }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_enemy = wr_c }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_since = global.date }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_day0 = global.num_days }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_cas0 = casualties }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_taken = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_lost = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_days = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_cas = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_capd = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_old = wr_old }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_surr = 0 }
	}
}

# Wars: the war with wr_c is over: its row moves to the finished wars with the end date, its length, what it
# cost and how it ended.
mod1440_wr_close = {
	set_temp_variable = { wr_j = -1 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_wr_enemy
		value = wr_v
		index = wr_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_v = wr_c } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_j = wr_i }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wr_j > -1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_out = token:mod1440_wr_out_peace }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_capd^wr_j = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_out = token:mod1440_wr_out_capitulated }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_array = { array = subjects value = wr_c } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_out = token:mod1440_wr_out_subject }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:wr_c = { exists = no } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_out = token:mod1440_wr_out_gone }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_capd^wr_j = 2 } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_out = token:mod1440_wr_out_annexed }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { wr_d = global.num_days }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wr_d = mod1440_wr_day0^wr_j }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_k = casualties }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wr_k = mod1440_wr_cas0^wr_j }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_enemy value = wr_c index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_since value = mod1440_wr_since^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_until value = global.date index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_days value = wr_d index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_cas value = wr_k index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_taken value = mod1440_wr_taken^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_lost value = mod1440_wr_lost^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_outcome value = wr_out index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_old value = mod1440_wr_old^wr_j index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_enemy index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_since index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_day0 index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_cas0 index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_taken index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_lost index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_days index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_cas index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_capd index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_old index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_surr index = wr_j }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_enemy^num > 200 } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_last = mod1440_wo_enemy^num }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wr_last = 1 }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_enemy index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_since index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_until index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_days index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_cas index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_taken index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_lost index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_outcome index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_old index = wr_last }
		}
	}
}

# Wars: one more state taken from (wr_f = 1) or lost to (wr_f = 2) the enemy in wr_c.
mod1440_wr_count = {
	set_temp_variable = { wr_j = -1 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_wr_enemy
		value = wr_v
		index = wr_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_v = wr_c } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_j = wr_i }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wr_j > -1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_f = 1 } }
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_wr_taken^wr_j = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_f = 2 } }
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_wr_lost^wr_j = 1 }
		}
	}
}
mod1440_wr_annexed = {
	set_temp_variable = { wr_j = -1 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_wr_enemy
		value = wr_v
		index = wr_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_v = wr_c } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_j = wr_i }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wr_j > -1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_capd^wr_j = 2 }
	}
}

# Wars: the numbers of today's rows, each enemy's surrender progress for its bar, and a line in the War
# Diary when an enemy or the country itself has capitulated.
mod1440_wr_daily = {
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_wr_enemy
		value = wr_v
		index = wr_i
		set_temp_variable = { wr_d = global.num_days }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wr_d = mod1440_wr_day0^wr_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_days^wr_i = wr_d }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_k = casualties }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wr_k = mod1440_wr_cas0^wr_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_cas^wr_i = wr_k }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_s = 0 }
		var:wr_v = {
			set_temp_variable = { wr_s = surrender_progress }
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { wr_s = 100 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_surr^wr_i = wr_s }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_capd^wr_i = 0 } var:wr_v = { has_capitulated = yes } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_capd^wr_i = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_capitulated }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 5 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = wr_v }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_capitulated = yes NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_capd = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_capd = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_we_capitulated }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 6 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_capitulated = no }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_capd = 0 }
	}
}

# The Records: what the window shows. Sets the buttons' frames and makes the list of the open page.
mod1440_rec_show = {
	mod1440_rec_odd = yes
	set_variable = { mod1440_rec_tab_0 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_rec_tab_1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_rec_tab_2 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_rec_tab_3 = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_rec_tab_0 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_rec_tab_1 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 2 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_rec_tab_2 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 3 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_rec_tab_3 = 2 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_hn_frame = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_hn_auto = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_hn_frame = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 0 } }
		mod1440_wd_list = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 1 } }
		mod1440_of_list = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 2 } }
		mod1440_gv_daily = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 3 } }
		mod1440_wr_daily = yes
	}
	add_to_variable = { mod1440_rec_dirty = 1 }
}

# The Records: the first run for the country in scope. Takes the copies the daily comparison needs, opens a
# row for each war that already runs and writes the first line.
mod1440_ev_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_begun = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_begun = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_hn_auto = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_since = global.date }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_since_day = global.num_days }
		mod1440_rec_odd = yes
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_begins }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
		for_each_loop = {
			array = enemies
			value = ev_c
			add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_enemies = ev_c }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_c = ev_c }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_old = 1 }
			mod1440_wr_open = yes
		}
		for_each_loop = {
			array = subjects
			value = ev_c
			add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_subjects = ev_c }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { ev_in = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_in = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_fac = ev_in }
		clear_array = mod1440_gv_fac
		for_each_loop = {
			array = faction_members
			value = ev_c
			add_to_array = { mod1440_gv_fac = ev_c }
		}
		mod1440_gv_daily = yes
		mod1440_of_seen = yes
	}
}

# The Records: once a day for a player's country. What no hook tells is found by comparing with yesterday:
# the end of a war, a new or lost subject, the faction, the offices. Then the numbers of the wars.
mod1440_rec_daily = {
	mod1440_ev_init = yes
	for_each_loop = {
		array = enemies
		value = ev_c
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_ev_enemies value = ev_c } } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_war_with }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 3 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = ev_c }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
			set_temp_variable = { wr_c = ev_c }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_old = 0 }
			mod1440_wr_open = yes
		}
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_ev_enemies
		value = ev_c
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = enemies value = ev_c } } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_peace }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 4 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = ev_c }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
			set_temp_variable = { wr_c = ev_c }
			mod1440_wr_close = yes
		}
	}
	clear_array = mod1440_ev_enemies
	for_each_loop = {
		array = enemies
		value = ev_c
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_enemies = ev_c }
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = subjects
		value = ev_c
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_ev_subjects value = ev_c } } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_subject_new }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 8 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = ev_c }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_ev_subjects
		value = ev_c
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = subjects value = ev_c } } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_subject_gone }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 9 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = ev_c }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
	}
	clear_array = mod1440_ev_subjects
	for_each_loop = {
		array = subjects
		value = ev_c
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_subjects = ev_c }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { ev_in = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_in = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_fac = ev_in } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ev_in = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_faction_in }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 10 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = faction_leader }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_faction_out }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 11 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_fac = ev_in }
		clear_array = mod1440_gv_fac
		for_each_loop = {
			array = faction_members
			value = ev_c
			add_to_array = { mod1440_gv_fac = ev_c }
		}
	}
	else = {
		for_each_loop = {
			array = faction_members
			value = ev_c
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_gv_fac value = ev_c } } }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_member_in }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 12 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_b = ev_c }
				mod1440_ev_add = yes
			}
		}
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_gv_fac
			value = ev_c
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = faction_members value = ev_c } } }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_member_out }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 13 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_b = ev_c }
				mod1440_ev_add = yes
			}
		}
		clear_array = mod1440_gv_fac
		for_each_loop = {
			array = faction_members
			value = ev_c
			add_to_array = { mod1440_gv_fac = ev_c }
		}
	}
	mod1440_wr_daily = yes
	mod1440_gv_daily = yes
	mod1440_of_seen = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_open = 1 } }
		mod1440_rec_show = yes
	}
}

# The Records: a war has begun between the country in scope and wr_c (a hook says who attacked).
mod1440_ev_war_on = {
	set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_war_on }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_b = wr_c }
	mod1440_ev_add = yes
	set_temp_variable = { wr_old = 0 }
	mod1440_wr_open = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_ev_enemies value = wr_c } } }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_enemies = wr_c }
	}
}
mod1440_ev_war_by = {
	set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_war_by }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 2 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_b = wr_c }
	mod1440_ev_add = yes
	set_temp_variable = { wr_old = 0 }
	mod1440_wr_open = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_ev_enemies value = wr_c } } }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_enemies = wr_c }
	}
}

# The Records: the country in scope has taken the state tr_s from tr_c (tr_cap = 1: a capital). A line, the
# count of the war, the general with the most divisions there, what the state card shows, and the honour.
mod1440_tr_taken = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { tr_cap = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_capital_taken }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 16 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = tr_s }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = tr_c }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_capital_taken }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 16 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = tr_s }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = tr_c }
		mod1440_tr_add = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_state_taken }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 14 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = tr_s }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = tr_c }
		mod1440_tr_add = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { wr_c = tr_c }
	set_temp_variable = { wr_f = 1 }
	mod1440_wr_count = yes
	set_temp_variable = { of_best = 0 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = army_leaders
		value = of_l
		var:of_l = {
			set_temp_variable = { of_n = num_units_in_state@var:tr_s }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { of_n > of_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_best = of_n }
			set_temp_variable = { of_who = of_l }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { of_best > 0 } }
		var:of_who = {
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_of_states = 1 }
		}
	}
	var:tr_s = {
		set_variable = { mod1440_sr_date = global.date }
		set_variable = { mod1440_sr_day = global.num_days }
		set_variable = { mod1440_sr_from = tr_c }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { tr_cap = 1 } check_variable = { mod1440_hn_auto = 1 } has_dlc = "By Blood Alone" }
		set_temp_variable = { hn_n = 0 }
		var:tr_s = {
			every_state_division = {
				limit = { OWNER = { tag = ROOT } }
				add_history_entry = {
					key = mod1440_hn_capture
					subject = "Capital"
					allow = no
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { hn_n = 1 }
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_hn_count = hn_n }
	}
}
mod1440_tr_lost = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { tr_cap = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_capital_lost }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 17 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = tr_s }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = tr_c }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_capital_lost }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 17 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = tr_s }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = tr_c }
		mod1440_tr_add = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_state_lost }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 15 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = tr_s }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = tr_c }
		mod1440_tr_add = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { wr_c = tr_c }
	set_temp_variable = { wr_f = 2 }
	mod1440_wr_count = yes
}
